title: An attacker who obtained the hardcoded key could decrypt domain/service account passwords, task run-as credentials,…
description: This vulnerability involves a hardcoded key in the GSS Deployment Server installation that, if obtained by an attacker, could allow decryption of sensitive credentials including domain/service account passwords, task run-as credentials, and sysprep passwords. The flaw has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.6. No affected versions or patch information are provided, and there are no known exploits in the wild at this time.
